Olympic decathlete; born 19 August 1944 at Camberwell; Royal Navy steward 1960-1971; Belgrave decathlon club record holder; RN 400m hurdles record 55.1 (1971); 3rd Inter-Services 400m hurdles and 2nd RN Decathlon 1971; decathlon best 6389 pts; 1972 won Surrey County 400m, 7th in A.A.A. Decathlon (6389 pts, 11th on British ranking list); represented Barbados at the Munich Olympic Games, retiring after the pole vault
